author: ValWood
body:
* **InterPro ID / label**


GO:0004106 | chorismate mutase activity | IEA with IPR008242


* **Example sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**


https://www.pombase.org/gene/SPBC30D10.16
https://www.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/O14361/entry

* **Description of issue**


in yeast this doesn't appear to be a chorismate mutase (which is IPR036263), or related to chorismate mutase (maybe the bacterial proteins referred to in  IPR008242 have an additional domain?)
title: GO:0004106	 chorismate mutase activity IEA with IPR008242

author: sarach06
body:
Hi Val,
Thank you very much for this. Yes, in IPR008242 there are bifunctional enzymes with chorismate mutase activity, so I removed the term in this entry to stop the wrong mapping to yeast proteins. I added GO:0004106 to the Chorismate mutase domain (IPR002701). These changes will be available in InterPro 104.0.
Best wishes,
Sara
